name: Isotrak Ltd
reason: Originally a UK fleet telematics solution provider, Isotrak was acquired by Connexas Group (now part of AddSecure) and no longer trades independently under its own name.

name: Flagship Partners Ltd
reason: Primarily a proactive consultancy and training provider focused on driver compliance and transport auditing services. Its fleet software is delivered via a partnership with external developer Convey Technology rather than being its own primary engineering business.

name: Masternaut Limited
reason: The company has been entirely rebranded and absorbed into MICHELIN Connected Fleet.

name: CanTrack Global Ltd
reason: Acquired by Radius Telematics and fully absorbed; its services and customers have been migrated to the Kinesis Pro platform.

name: Brightmile Limited
reason: The company was acquired by Smith System and rebranded to 5Keys Engage.
